editorial_note: Concise support adaptations of the published FAQ. Check the original page for complete and current terms.

items.question: How do I activate Badi?
items.answer: Choose a plan in the Badi app and follow activation instructions. Your device must support eSIM.

items.question: Why is there no internet?
items.answer: Check activation, coverage and mobile data, then restart your device. If the issue continues, start a support chat.

items.question: Will my device work?
items.answer: Check compatibility in the Badi app. For carrier-locked devices, confirm eSIM support with your manufacturer or carrier.

items.question: How can I get more data?
items.answer: Check your balance and buy additional data in the Badi app. Plans are prepaid and do not auto-renew.

items.question: Can I use a hotspot?
items.answer: Hotspot is supported and uses your plan’s data. Device limits and network conditions can affect performance.

items.question: Is my destination covered?
items.answer: Check current destination coverage and plan details in the Badi app or website before purchasing.

items.question: Can I request a refund?
items.answer: Refund eligibility depends on Badi’s terms. Contact support to discuss your purchase.

items.question: Lost device or suspicious activity?
items.answer: Contact Badi support promptly for help securing your account.
